# Hourly API – specifikacija

<!-- Generated by `npm run openapi:export` from apps/api/src/openapi.ts. Do not edit. -->

Versija 0.1.0. Mašinai skaitoma specifikacija – [api-spec.yaml](../api-spec.yaml) (OpenAPI 3.1), interaktyvi – Swagger UI adresu `/api/docs`. Šis puslapis sugeneruotas iš to paties dokumento.

Bazinis adresas: `http://localhost:4000/api`. Visos klaidos grąžinamos vienodu formatu `{ "error": { "code", "message", "details" } }`.

Pavyzdžiai **užfiksuoti** paleidus Postman kolekciją su pradiniais duomenimis – tai tikri sąsajos atsakymai. Ilgi sąrašai sutrumpinti iki dviejų elementų, JWT parašas pakeistas `<signature>`. Kodams, kurių kolekcija konkrečiam metodui nesukelia (pvz., 403 užblokuotai paskyrai), pateikiamas **tipinis** atsakymas.

## Authentication

### POST /auth/register

**Register, choosing the client or specialist role**

The administrator role cannot be chosen. The new user is signed in at once: the response carries the access token and sets the `hourly_refresh` cookie.

Autentifikacija: nereikia.

Užklausos kūnas: `application/json` (schema – `api-spec.yaml`).

| Atsako kodas | Reikšmė | Pavyzdys |
|---|---|---|
| 201 Created | Account created and signed in | užfiksuotas |
| 400 Bad Request | Bad request | tipinis |
| 409 Conflict | An account with this e-mail already exists (EMAIL_TAKEN) | užfiksuotas |
| 422 Unprocessable Entity | Validation failed | užfiksuotas |
| 429 Too Many Requests | Too many attempts (TOO_MANY_REQUESTS); retry after `Retry-After` seconds | tipinis |

### POST /auth/login

**Sign in**

An unknown e-mail and a wrong password get the same 401. A blocked account gets 403 only after its password has been verified. Ten failed attempts for one e-mail from one address within 15 minutes are answered 429 until the window passes; successful sign-ins are not counted.

Autentifikacija: nereikia.

Užklausos kūnas: `application/json` (schema – `api-spec.yaml`).

| Atsako kodas | Reikšmė | Pavyzdys |
|---|---|---|
| 200 OK | Signed in | užfiksuotas |
| 400 Bad Request | Bad request | tipinis |
| 401 Unauthorized | Incorrect e-mail or password (INVALID_CREDENTIALS) | užfiksuotas |
| 403 Forbidden | The account is blocked (ACCOUNT_BLOCKED) | užfiksuotas |
| 422 Unprocessable Entity | Validation failed | tipinis |
| 429 Too Many Requests | Too many attempts (TOO_MANY_REQUESTS); retry after `Retry-After` seconds | užfiksuotas |

```http
}
```

### POST /auth/refresh

**Refresh the access token (token rotation)**

The refresh token is read from the `hourly_refresh` cookie only. Every refresh revokes the presented token and sets a new one, so each token works once. Presenting an already used token revokes every token of that login (REFRESH_TOKEN_REUSED).

Autentifikacija: atnaujinimo žetono slapukas `hourly_refresh`.

| Atsako kodas | Reikšmė | Pavyzdys |
|---|---|---|
| 200 OK | New tokens issued | užfiksuotas |
| 401 Unauthorized | Missing, unknown or expired token (INVALID_REFRESH_TOKEN), or a reused one (REFRESH_TOKEN_REUSED) | užfiksuotas |
| 403 Forbidden | The account is blocked (ACCOUNT_BLOCKED) | tipinis |
| 429 Too Many Requests | Too many attempts (TOO_MANY_REQUESTS); retry after `Retry-After` seconds | tipinis |

<details open>
<summary>200 OK – New tokens issued</summary>

Užklausa:

```http
POST /api/auth/refresh HTTP/1.1
Cookie: hourly_refresh=<atnaujinimo žetonas>
```

Atsakymas:

```http
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "accessToken": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJyb2xlIjoiU1BFQ0lBTElTVCIsInNpZCI6IjYxOWEyNjgxLTExYTEtNDczNy05NWE0LWY5Zjk0NmFjZDg1MSIsImlhdCI6MTc5MzU1NDUwMiwiZXhwIjoxNzkzNTU1NDAyLCJhdWQiOiJob3VybHkiLCJpc3MiOiJob3VybHktYXBpIiwic3ViIjoiMTMyNTgwNTItZDE2ZC00MTEyLTgxM2QtMjUzZDQ1M2I3MmQ3In0.<signature>",
  "user": {
    "id": "13258052-d16d-4112-813d-253d453b72d7",
    "displayName": "Demonstracinis specialistas",
    "role": "SPECIALIST",
    "bio": null,
    "createdAt": "2026-11-01T17:35:02.029Z",
    "email": "demo-1793554501506@example.lt",
    "isBlocked": false
  }
}
```

</details>

<details>
<summary>401 Unauthorized – Missing, unknown or expired token (INVALID_REFRESH_TOKEN), or a reused one (REFRESH_TOKEN_REUSED)</summary>

Užklausa:

```http
POST /api/auth/refresh HTTP/1.1

```

Atsakymas:

### POST /auth/logout

**Sign out**

Ends this login: revokes every refresh token of it and clears the cookie. The access tokens of the login stop working at once too - they name it in their `sid` claim, so the next request with one answers 401 SESSION_REVOKED. Works without an access token and without a cookie (idempotent).

Autentifikacija: atnaujinimo žetono slapukas `hourly_refresh`.

| Atsako kodas | Reikšmė | Pavyzdys |
|---|---|---|
| 204 No Content | Signed out | užfiksuotas |

<details open>
<summary>204 No Content – Signed out</summary>

Užklausa:

```http
POST /api/auth/logout HTTP/1.1
Cookie: hourly_refresh=<atnaujinimo žetonas>
```

Atsakymas:

```http
HTTP/1.1 204 No Content
```

</details>

### PATCH /auth/me

**Edit own name, bio or password**

A new password requires `currentPassword`. Changing the password signs out every other login of the account.

Autentifikacija: `Authorization: Bearer <prieigos žetonas>`.

Užklausos kūnas: `application/json` (schema – `api-spec.yaml`).

| Atsako kodas | Reikšmė | Pavyzdys |
|---|---|---|
| 200 OK | Updated user | užfiksuotas |
| 400 Bad Request | Bad request | tipinis |
| 401 Unauthorized | Not authenticated | tipinis |
| 422 Unprocessable Entity | Invalid content or wrong current password (INVALID_PASSWORD) | užfiksuotas |

## Projects

### GET /projects

**List projects**

`scope=marketplace` - publicly published (no token needed), `scope=owned` - created by the user, `scope=assigned` - carried out by the user, `scope=all` - every project, for the administrator only (403 otherwise).

Autentifikacija: neprivaloma – su žetonu atsakymas priklauso nuo naudotojo.

| Parametras | Vieta | Tipas | Privalomas | Aprašymas |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `page` | užklausa | integer | ne |  |
| `perPage` | užklausa | integer | ne |  |
| `scope` | užklausa | `marketplace`, `owned`, `assigned`, `all` | ne |  |
| `q` | užklausa | string | ne |  |
| `status` | užklausa | `DRAFT`, `PUBLISHED`, `IN_PROGRESS`, `COMPLETED`, `CANCELLED` | ne |  |
| `origin` | užklausa | `MARKETPLACE`, `DIRECT` | ne |  |

| Atsako kodas | Reikšmė | Pavyzdys |
|---|---|---|
| 200 OK | Project list | užfiksuotas |
| 400 Bad Request | Bad request | užfiksuotas |
| 401 Unauthorized | Not authenticated | tipinis |
| 403 Forbidden | Not allowed | užfiksuotas |

### POST /projects

**Create a project**

MARKETPLACE: the actor becomes the client and the project starts as DRAFT. DIRECT: the actor becomes the specialist, `externalClientName` is required and the project starts as IN_PROGRESS. A MARKETPLACE project is created by a client, a DIRECT one by a specialist; any other role gets 403.

Autentifikacija: `Authorization: Bearer <prieigos žetonas>`.

Užklausos kūnas: `application/json` (schema – `api-spec.yaml`).

| Atsako kodas | Reikšmė | Pavyzdys |
|---|---|---|
| 201 Created | Project created | užfiksuotas |
| 400 Bad Request | Bad request | užfiksuotas |
| 401 Unauthorized | Not authenticated | užfiksuotas |
| 403 Forbidden | Not allowed | užfiksuotas |
| 422 Unprocessable Entity | Validation failed | užfiksuotas |

### PATCH /projects/{id}

### DELETE /projects/{id}

**Delete a project**

Tasks, work sessions, proposals and share links are removed with it. Allowed to the creator of the project (the client of a MARKETPLACE project, the specialist of a DIRECT one) and to the administrator.

Autentifikacija: `Authorization: Bearer <prieigos žetonas>`.

| Parametras | Vieta | Tipas | Privalomas | Aprašymas |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | adresas | string (uuid) | taip |  |

| Atsako kodas | Reikšmė | Pavyzdys |
|---|---|---|
| 204 No Content | Deleted | užfiksuotas |
| 400 Bad Request | Bad request | tipinis |
| 401 Unauthorized | Not authenticated | tipinis |
| 403 Forbidden | Not allowed | užfiksuotas |
| 404 Not Found | Not found | tipinis |

### GET /projects/{id}/report

**Project report by task and accumulated hours**

One resource in two representations, selected with the `Accept` header: `application/json` (the default) or `text/csv`, which is returned as a download. Anything else answers 406. Only finished work sessions are counted - a running session has no duration yet. Readable by the parties of the project and the administrator.

Autentifikacija: `Authorization: Bearer <prieigos žetonas>`.

| Parametras | Vieta | Tipas | Privalomas | Aprašymas |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | adresas | string (uuid) | taip |  |

| Atsako kodas | Reikšmė | Pavyzdys |
|---|---|---|
| 200 OK | Report | užfiksuotas |
| 400 Bad Request | Bad request | tipinis |
| 401 Unauthorized | Not authenticated | tipinis |
| 403 Forbidden | Not allowed | tipinis |
| 404 Not Found | Not found | užfiksuotas |
| 406 Not Acceptable | The requested media type is not available | užfiksuotas |

## Tasks

### GET /tasks

**My tasks across projects**

A personal view, not a second address: tasks of the projects the actor takes part in; `projectId` narrows it to one, `status` and `q` (title and description) filter it. Each task lives at `/projects/{projectId}/tasks/{taskId}`.

Autentifikacija: `Authorization: Bearer <prieigos žetonas>`.

| Parametras | Vieta | Tipas | Privalomas | Aprašymas |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `page` | užklausa | integer | ne |  |
| `perPage` | užklausa | integer | ne |  |
| `status` | užklausa | `TODO`, `IN_PROGRESS`, `BLOCKED`, `DONE` | ne |  |
| `q` | užklausa | string | ne |  |
| `projectId` | užklausa | string (uuid) | ne |  |

| 403 Forbidden | Not allowed | tipinis |

### POST /projects/{projectId}/tasks

**Create a task in the project**

Written by whoever the project named in `taskAuthoring`. Omitting `position` appends the task to the end of the list. The `Location` header points at the new task.

Autentifikacija: `Authorization: Bearer <prieigos žetonas>`.

| Parametras | Vieta | Tipas | Privalomas | Aprašymas |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `projectId` | adresas | string (uuid) | taip |  |

Užklausos kūnas: `application/json` (schema – `api-spec.yaml`).

| Atsako kodas | Reikšmė | Pavyzdys |
|---|---|---|
| 201 Created | Task created | užfiksuotas |
| 400 Bad Request | Bad request | tipinis |
| 401 Unauthorized | Not authenticated | tipinis |
| 403 Forbidden | Not allowed | tipinis |
| 404 Not Found | Not found | užfiksuotas |
| 422 Unprocessable Entity | Validation failed | užfiksuotas |

### PATCH /projects/{projectId}/tasks/{taskId}

**Update a task, move it, change its status or approve it**

Both parties of the project may edit and reorder tasks. `approved` is the decision of the client and applies only when the specialist authored the list.

| Parametras | Vieta | Tipas | Privalomas | Aprašymas |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `projectId` | adresas | string (uuid) | taip |  |

## Work sessions

### GET /sessions

**My work log across projects**

A personal view, not a second address: the sessions of the actor. `projectId` and `taskId` narrow it, `from`/`to` select by start time (`from <= startedAt < to`), `running=true` finds the timer still going. `projectId` and `taskId` of each entry give its address under `/projects/{projectId}/tasks/{taskId}/sessions`.

Autentifikacija: `Authorization: Bearer <prieigos žetonas>`.

| Parametras | Vieta | Tipas | Privalomas | Aprašymas |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `page` | užklausa | integer | ne |  |
| `perPage` | užklausa | integer | ne |  |
| `projectId` | užklausa | string (uuid) | ne |  |
| `taskId` | užklausa | string (uuid) | ne |  |
| `from` | užklausa |  | ne |  |
| `to` | užklausa |  | ne |  |
| `running` | užklausa | `true`, `false` | ne |  |

| Atsako kodas | Reikšmė | Pavyzdys |
|---|---|---|
| 200 OK | Session list | užfiksuotas |
| 400 Bad Request | Bad request | užfiksuotas |
| 401 Unauthorized | Not authenticated | tipinis |
| 403 Forbidden | Not allowed | tipinis |

### GET /projects/{projectId}/tasks/{taskId}/sessions

**Work sessions of a task (project -> task -> sessions)**

The whole hierarchy in one address. A missing project, or a task that does not belong to it, answers 404 - not an empty list. Logged hours are readable by the parties of the project and the administrator. `from`/`to` select by start time (`from <= startedAt < to`), `running` by whether the timer is going.

Autentifikacija: `Authorization: Bearer <prieigos žetonas>`.

| Parametras | Vieta | Tipas | Privalomas | Aprašymas |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `projectId` | adresas | string (uuid) | taip |  |
| `taskId` | adresas | string (uuid) | taip |  |
| `page` | užklausa | integer | ne |  |
| `perPage` | užklausa | integer | ne |  |
| `from` | užklausa |  | ne |  |
| `to` | užklausa |  | ne |  |
| `running` | užklausa | `true`, `false` | ne |  |

| Atsako kodas | Reikšmė | Pavyzdys |
|---|---|---|
| 200 OK | Session list | užfiksuotas |
| 400 Bad Request | Bad request | tipinis |
| 401 Unauthorized | Not authenticated | tipinis |
| 403 Forbidden | Not allowed | tipinis |
| 404 Not Found | Not found - also when a child is addressed under a parent it does not belong to | tipinis |

### POST /projects/{projectId}/tasks/{taskId}/sessions

**Start a work session or enter one manually**

Without `endedAt` the session is treated as running. A user may have only one unfinished session at a time, so a second one answers 409. `durationMinutes` and `appliedRate` are computed by the server and cannot be sent in.

Autentifikacija: `Authorization: Bearer <prieigos žetonas>`.

| Parametras | Vieta | Tipas | Privalomas | Aprašymas |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `projectId` | adresas | string (uuid) | taip |  |
| `taskId` | adresas | string (uuid) | taip |  |

Užklausos kūnas: `application/json` (schema – `api-spec.yaml`).

| Atsako kodas | Reikšmė | Pavyzdys |
|---|---|---|
| 201 Created | Session created | užfiksuotas |
| 400 Bad Request | Bad request | tipinis |
| 401 Unauthorized | Not authenticated | tipinis |
| 403 Forbidden | Not allowed | tipinis |
| 404 Not Found | Not found - also when a child is addressed under a parent it does not belong to | tipinis |
| 409 Conflict | A work session is already running | užfiksuotas |
| 422 Unprocessable Entity | Validation failed | tipinis |

### PATCH /projects/{projectId}/tasks/{taskId}/sessions/{sessionId}

**Update or finish a work session**

Sending `endedAt` stops the timer: the server then measures the duration and locks in the rate that was in force. Only the author may change a session.

Autentifikacija: `Authorization: Bearer <prieigos žetonas>`.

| Parametras | Vieta | Tipas | Privalomas | Aprašymas |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `projectId` | adresas | string (uuid) | taip |  |
| `taskId` | adresas | string (uuid) | taip |  |
| `sessionId` | adresas | string (uuid) | taip |  |

Užklausos kūnas: `application/json` (schema – `api-spec.yaml`).

| Atsako kodas | Reikšmė | Pavyzdys |
|---|---|---|
| 200 OK | Session updated | užfiksuotas |
| 400 Bad Request | Bad request | tipinis |
| 401 Unauthorized | Not authenticated | tipinis |
| 403 Forbidden | Not allowed | tipinis |
| 404 Not Found | Not found - also when a child is addressed under a parent it does not belong to | tipinis |
| 409 Conflict | Reopening would leave two sessions running | tipinis |
| 422 Unprocessable Entity | Validation failed | tipinis |

### GET /projects/{projectId}/proposals

**Proposals submitted for a project**

Competing bids reveal prices, so the client sees every offer while a specialist sees only their own. `status` filters the list.

Autentifikacija: `Authorization: Bearer <prieigos žetonas>`.

| Parametras | Vieta | Tipas | Privalomas | Aprašymas |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `projectId` | adresas | string (uuid) | taip |  |
| `page` | užklausa | integer | ne |  |
| `perPage` | užklausa | integer | ne |  |
| `status` | užklausa | `PENDING`, `ACCEPTED`, `REJECTED`, `WITHDRAWN` | ne |  |

| Atsako kodas | Reikšmė | Pavyzdys |
|---|---|---|
| 200 OK | Proposal list | užfiksuotas |
| 400 Bad Request | Bad request | tipinis |
| 401 Unauthorized | Not authenticated | tipinis |
| 403 Forbidden | Not allowed | tipinis |
| 404 Not Found | Not found | tipinis |

### POST /projects/{projectId}/proposals

**Submit a proposal for a project**

Only while the project is a PUBLISHED marketplace project. One offer per specialist per project, so a repeated attempt answers 409.

Autentifikacija: `Authorization: Bearer <prieigos žetonas>`.

| Parametras | Vieta | Tipas | Privalomas | Aprašymas |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `projectId` | adresas | string (uuid) | taip |  |

Užklausos kūnas: `application/json` (schema – `api-spec.yaml`).

| Atsako kodas | Reikšmė | Pavyzdys |
|---|---|---|
| 201 Created | Proposal submitted | užfiksuotas |
| 400 Bad Request | Bad request | tipinis |
| 401 Unauthorized | Not authenticated | tipinis |
| 403 Forbidden | Not allowed | užfiksuotas |
| 404 Not Found | Not found | tipinis |
| 409 Conflict | This specialist has already bid on the project | tipinis |
| 422 Unprocessable Entity | Validation failed | tipinis |

### PATCH /projects/{projectId}/proposals/{proposalId}

**Accept, reject or withdraw a proposal**

ACCEPTED and REJECTED are decisions of the client, WITHDRAWN belongs to the specialist, and only a PENDING proposal can be changed. Accepting runs in one transaction: the offer wins, the competing offers are rejected, and the project moves to IN_PROGRESS with the specialist assigned. Only one proposal per project may be accepted.

Autentifikacija: `Authorization: Bearer <prieigos žetonas>`.

| Parametras | Vieta | Tipas | Privalomas | Aprašymas |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `projectId` | adresas | string (uuid) | taip |  |
| `proposalId` | adresas | string (uuid) | taip |  |

Užklausos kūnas: `application/json` (schema – `api-spec.yaml`).

| Atsako kodas | Reikšmė | Pavyzdys |
|---|---|---|
| 200 OK | Proposal updated | užfiksuotas |
| 400 Bad Request | Bad request | tipinis |
| 401 Unauthorized | Not authenticated | tipinis |
| 403 Forbidden | Not allowed | tipinis |
| 404 Not Found | Not found - also when a child is addressed under a parent it does not belong to | tipinis |
| 409 Conflict | Another proposal of this project is already accepted | tipinis |
| 422 Unprocessable Entity | Validation failed | tipinis |

### POST /projects/{projectId}/shares

**Generate a share link**

The token is readable only in this response: the database keeps nothing but its SHA-256 hash, so a lost link cannot be recovered, only replaced.

Autentifikacija: `Authorization: Bearer <prieigos žetonas>`.

| Parametras | Vieta | Tipas | Privalomas | Aprašymas |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `projectId` | adresas | string (uuid) | taip |  |

Užklausos kūnas: `application/json` (schema – `api-spec.yaml`).

| 201 Created | Share link created | užfiksuotas |
| 400 Bad Request | Bad request | tipinis |
| 401 Unauthorized | Not authenticated | tipinis |
| 403 Forbidden | Not allowed | tipinis |

### GET /public/projects/{token}

**Project progress behind a share link**

Accessible without an account, read-only. A link that does not exist, one that was revoked and one that expired all answer an identical 404, so a visitor cannot probe which tokens once existed. The response carries an `X-Robots-Tag: noindex` header because the token travels in the address.

Autentifikacija: nereikia.

| Parametras | Vieta | Tipas | Privalomas | Aprašymas |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `token` | adresas | string | taip |  |

| Atsako kodas | Reikšmė | Pavyzdys |
|---|---|---|
| 200 OK | Project progress | užfiksuotas |
| 400 Bad Request | Malformed token in the address | tipinis |
| 404 Not Found | Link is invalid, revoked or not found | užfiksuotas |

## Users

### GET /users

**All accounts (administrator)**

Includes the e-mail and the blocked flag. `q` searches the name and the e-mail; `role` and `isBlocked` narrow the list.

Autentifikacija: `Authorization: Bearer <prieigos žetonas>`.

| Parametras | Vieta | Tipas | Privalomas | Aprašymas |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `page` | užklausa | integer | ne |  |
| `perPage` | užklausa | integer | ne |  |
| `q` | užklausa | string | ne |  |
| `role` | užklausa | `CLIENT`, `SPECIALIST`, `ADMIN` | ne |  |
| `isBlocked` | užklausa | `true`, `false` | ne |  |

| Atsako kodas | Reikšmė | Pavyzdys |
|---|---|---|
| 200 OK | User list | užfiksuotas |
| 400 Bad Request | Bad request | tipinis |
| 401 Unauthorized | Not authenticated | tipinis |
| 403 Forbidden | Not an administrator | užfiksuotas |

### GET /users/{id}

### PATCH /users/{id}

**Block or unblock an account (administrator)**

Blocking revokes every refresh token of the account and rejects its access tokens from the next request on (ACCOUNT_BLOCKED). An administrator cannot block their own account.

Autentifikacija: `Authorization: Bearer <prieigos žetonas>`.

| Parametras | Vieta | Tipas | Privalomas | Aprašymas |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | adresas | string (uuid) | taip |  |

Užklausos kūnas: `application/json` (schema – `api-spec.yaml`).

| Atsako kodas | Reikšmė | Pavyzdys |
|---|---|---|
| 200 OK | Updated account | užfiksuotas |
| 400 Bad Request | Bad request | tipinis |
| 401 Unauthorized | Not authenticated | tipinis |
| 403 Forbidden | Not an administrator | tipinis |
| 404 Not Found | Not found | tipinis |
| 422 Unprocessable Entity | Invalid content, or the own account (CANNOT_MODIFY_SELF) | užfiksuotas |

<details open>
<summary>200 OK – Updated account</summary>

Užklausa:

```http
PATCH /api/users/13258052-d16d-4112-813d-253d453b72d7 HTTP/1.1
Authorization: Bearer <prieigos žetonas>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "isBlocked": true
}
```

Atsakymas:

```http
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "id": "13258052-d16d-4112-813d-253d453b72d7",
  "displayName": "Demonstracinė paskyra",
  "role": "SPECIALIST",
  "bio": "Sukurta ir ištrinama demonstracijos metu.",
  "createdAt": "2026-11-01T17:35:02.029Z",
  "email": "demo-1793554501506@example.lt",
  "isBlocked": true,
  "_links": {
    "self": {
      "href": "/api/users/13258052-d16d-4112-813d-253d453b72d7"
    }
  }
}
```

</details>

### DELETE /users/{id}

**Delete an account without work history (administrator)**

An account that takes part in projects or has logged work answers 409 (USER_HAS_WORK_HISTORY) - deleting it would erase records of the other party, so it should be blocked instead.

Autentifikacija: `Authorization: Bearer <prieigos žetonas>`.

| Parametras | Vieta | Tipas | Privalomas | Aprašymas |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | adresas | string (uuid) | taip |  |

| Atsako kodas | Reikšmė | Pavyzdys |
|---|---|---|
| 204 No Content | Deleted | užfiksuotas |
| 400 Bad Request | Bad request | tipinis |
| 401 Unauthorized | Not authenticated | tipinis |
| 403 Forbidden | Not an administrator | užfiksuotas |
| 404 Not Found | Not found | tipinis |
| 409 Conflict | The account has work history (USER_HAS_WORK_HISTORY) | užfiksuotas |
| 422 Unprocessable Entity | The own account (CANNOT_MODIFY_SELF) | tipinis |

<details open>

Užklausa:

```http

Authorization: Bearer <prieigos žetonas>
```

Atsakymas:

```http
HTTP/1.1 204 No Content
```

</details>

```http
}
```

## Operations

### GET /

**Entry point: links to everything the caller can reach**

A client that knows only this address can discover the others by following `_links`. What is offered depends on the caller: a guest gets the marketplace and the way in, a signed-in user their own collections, the administrator the user list as well.

Autentifikacija: neprivaloma – su žetonu atsakymas priklauso nuo naudotojo.

| Atsako kodas | Reikšmė | Pavyzdys |
|---|---|---|
| 200 OK | Entry point | užfiksuotas |

<details open>
<summary>200 OK – Entry point</summary>

Užklausa:

```http
GET /api HTTP/1.1
```

Atsakymas:

```http
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "name": "Hourly API",
  "_links": {
    "self": {
      "href": "/api"
    },
    "marketplace": {
      "href": "/api/projects?scope=marketplace"
    },
    "docs": {
      "href": "/api/docs"
    },
    "openapi": {
      "href": "/api/openapi.json"
    },
    "register": {
      "href": "/api/auth/register",
      "method": "POST"
    },
    "login": {
      "href": "/api/auth/login",
      "method": "POST"
    }
  }
}
```

</details>

### GET /health

**Liveness probe**

Autentifikacija: nereikia.

| Atsako kodas | Reikšmė | Pavyzdys |
|---|---|---|
| 200 OK | Service is up | užfiksuotas |

<details open>
<summary>200 OK – Service is up</summary>

Užklausa:

```http
GET /api/health HTTP/1.1
```

Atsakymas:

```http
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "status": "ok",
  "uptime": 16.7575862
}
```

</details>

### GET /health/ready

**Readiness probe: the service and its database**

Answers 503 when the database cannot be reached, so a load balancer or a deployment slot swap can wait for it.

Autentifikacija: nereikia.

| Atsako kodas | Reikšmė | Pavyzdys |
|---|---|---|
| 200 OK | Ready to serve | užfiksuotas |
| 503 Service Unavailable | The database is unreachable | tipinis |

<details open>
<summary>200 OK – Ready to serve</summary>

Užklausa:

```http
GET /api/health/ready HTTP/1.1
```

Atsakymas:

```http
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "status": "ok",
  "database": "up"
}
```

</details>

<details>
<summary>503 Service Unavailable – The database is unreachable (tipinis atsakymas)</summary>

```http
HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "status": "degraded",
  "database": "down"
}
```

</details>
